Effect of Code

The supplemented code identified in SMC 1.01.010(A) is intended to be an official statement of the general ordinances of the City of Spokane as of December 31, 1996.

Date Passed: Monday, January 22, 2007

Effective Date: Sunday, March 4, 2007

Recodification ORD C33969 Section 1
